facts.fact: 开战以来她头一次动了躲进地堡不出去的念头——随即为这份恐惧羞愧
facts.anchor: For the first time since I started this war

facts.fact: 自我动员落点：她必须救下 Madame Leóne
facts.anchor: I had to save Madame Leóne.

facts.fact: 跟踪 Madame Leóne 进了裁缝店——Jacque Denue 之父的店，九年前他们父女曾被它关门拒卖
facts.anchor: the shop owned by Jacque Denue’s father

facts.fact: Grenault 自曝狩猎法：在煤矿只能遇到男人，裁缝店常有漂亮女人留地址——方便月夜上门
facts.anchor: under  the  light  of  the moon

facts.fact: 他当着她的面品评 Lisette 的名字像歌剧，还悬想咬下去时她会唱得多甜
facts.anchor: I wonder how sweet she’ll sing when I bite into her.

facts.fact: 灭口威胁：若她把狼群秘密告诉 Madame Leóne，他只好让流言止步于这间屋子
facts.anchor: That might force me to stop any such rumors from leaving this room.

facts.fact: Madame Denue 把 Lisette 的地址纸条收进衣袋，Grenault 声称今晚就把纸条偷到手
facts.anchor: I suppose I’ll have to relieve Madame Denue of that address tonight.

facts.fact: 结尾：她料定他今晚会去 Denue 家，虽然不知道黑暗里怎么打——但她会等着
